summary: The PR addresses the issue with using exclude on annotated FilteredRelation but introduces some style inconsistencies and could benefit from additional clarity.

issues.description: The new test file `reproduce.py` uses a different style for setting up the Django environment compared to the rest of the Django test suite. It should follow the conventions used in Django's test setup.
The added code could be made more readable by breaking down the logic into smaller functions or adding comments to explain the purpose of each step.
